name: ep_valuation
description: Value a company as Book Value + PV(Future Economic Profits) with competitive fade (Bergen et al. 2025, FAJ). Economic Profit = (ROIC − WACC) × Invested Capital. The IVM ratio (Intrinsic Value / Market Cap) is the primary screening metric.

ic_growth_rate.description: Invested capital growth rate. Range 0.0–0.30. Default 0.0.

moat_result.description: Moat classification from moat_check. Used when moat_override absent.

stage1_years.description: Hold current EP constant before fade. Range 1–5. Default 3.
